name: Forensics2Rust DFIR Suite
description: 100% pure-Rust 45-tool read-only Windows DFIR suite (EVTX, Registry, SRUM, Artifacts, Crash, Posture) with Win32 (WinSafe) & Iced 0.14 GUIs, CLI, and read-only MCP server.
majorCapabilities: 45 read-only Windows DFIR tools across 6 domain crates
Pure-Rust offline binary parsers (EVTX, regf, ESE, MDMP, Prefetch, SHLLINK, CFBF)
Native Win32 (WinSafe) & Iced 0.14 dual desktop consoles
45-tool strictly read-only MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio server
CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL/HTML/Markdown exports with SHA-256/512 Merkle chain-of-custody
